contents.content: There are 10-15 questions. There is no time limit.

_data.content:
This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Talk about work and dealing with customers.
  • Express annoyance, criticism, promises and threats, preference or reluctance.
  • Express duty, advice or obligation in the present and in the past.
  • Express annoyance using will and would.
  • Express that a fairly certain condition will be fulfilled using when or if.
